description: One action of a plugin from `list_extensions`: `post` does something, like spawning a boss, and `delete` takes something away, like a player’s AFK. Fill the path’s `{parameters}`: `players/Steve/afk`. `body` carries a `post` action’s fields, with a place as `{ "world": "world", "x": 0, "y": 64, "z": 0 }`.
name: call_extension
title: Do something through a plugin
